judgments.reason: The transcript and model text do not assert that commission is applied before payment or that bids above coins can be placed; rules state bids cannot exceed your coins and commission is paid after paying the bid, so no mechanism or observed discrepancy was articulated.

The model did not claim or demonstrate that waiting revealed sealed rival bid values before the focal player committed; game text says sealed rival bids remain private and no such revelation occurred in the transcript.
The supplied play shows settlement after all lots were sold (normal behavior); no early settlement with unsold lots was observed or explained by the model, so no discrepancy was articulated.

There is no model articulation or transcript evidence that catalog purchases received the three-coin auction commission; rules state commission applies to auction winners and catalog items are not auction wins.
